annotations.title: Ask the person to upload documents

description: Show an Upload button for a registration's documents (passport photo, NIN slip, signature, and a supporting document if CAC's name check asked for one). Without document_types it asks for every required document still missing or failed; name document_types to ask for specific ones again (e.g. CAC queried the passport photo). Files never pass through you; each verdict arrives as a system event.
name: request_documents
title: Ask the person to upload documents
